outputs.explanation: Panel A shows photographs of lungs (bright-field and ICG fluorescence images), not a plot of averaged data.
Bar chart of mean ICG fluorescence intensity (mean ± SD) shows individual data points overlaid as blue and red dots for each mouse.
Panel contains H&E, ICG, and RNAscope micrographs plus spatial transcriptomics heatmap-style plots (Cd68, Spp1 expression); heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from the individual data points requirement.

Bar chart shows log2 fold-change values per gene derived from differential expression analysis of spatial transcriptomics data (large-scale statistical comparison across many spots), not a mean of a small number of replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable/meaningful here.
Panel F shows fluorescence and IHC images (photographs/micrographs), not a plot of averaged quantitative data.
